pose: Full side profile of a stocky, low-slung Majungasaurus. Body, head, and tail are held in a perfectly straight horizontal line to showcase its unique 'sausage-like' proportions. It has a short, deep snout with a single rounded horn on the forehead. Energetic expression with a soulful smirk. Muscular, shorter legs firmly planted. Massive negative space buffers above and below to ensure 17:7 crop safety. No insects; focus is on the dense, pebbled skin texture and body mass.
